## Common WHERE Filters

读取该表时最常用的分区过滤器：

```sql
-- 标准读取（~100% 查询）
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')

-- campaign_day 窗口过滤（按使用频率排序）
AND campaign_day BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_30D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')  -- ~60%
AND campaign_day >= DATE('${PREV_30D}')                                      -- ~20%
AND campaign_day BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_14D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')  -- ~10%
AND campaign_day BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_7D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')   -- ~5%
AND campaign_day >= DATE('${PREV_21D}')                                      -- ~5%
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Pattern 1: 创建 dim_campaign_day CTE 后排除（最常用）

```sql
-- Step 1: 创建 CTE
create or replace temporary view dim_campaign_day as (
    select campaign_day
    from mp_paidads.dim_campaign_day__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      and campaign_day between date('${PREV_30D}') and date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
);

-- Step 2a: NOT IN 排除
SELECT ... FROM ...
WHERE grass_date NOT IN (SELECT campaign_day FROM dim_campaign_day)

-- Step 2b: LEFT JOIN 排除
SELECT ... FROM main_table a
LEFT JOIN dim_campaign_day b ON a.grass_date = b.campaign_day
WHERE b.campaign_day IS NULL

-- Step 2c: LEFT ANTI JOIN 排除
SELECT ... FROM main_table
LEFT ANTI JOIN dim_campaign_day ON grass_date = campaign_day
WHERE ...
```

### Pattern 2: LEFT JOIN 标记当天是否为 campaign day

```sql
left join dim_campaign_day g
  on a.grass_date = g.campaign_day
...
if(g.campaign_day IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS is_campaign_today
```

### Pattern 3: LEFT JOIN 排除后计算指标（排除 campaign day 的 14d 指标）

```sql
SUM(CASE
    WHEN grass_date BETWEEN DATE('${PREV_14D}') AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      AND b.campaign_day IS NULL
    THEN broad_gmv_amt_local_1d
END) AS broad_order_gmv_amt_local_14d
```

### Pattern 4: COUNT campaign days 用于归一化分母

```sql
sum(CASE WHEN b.campaign_day IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_campaign_day
...
sum(platform_gmv_usd_1d) / (7 - sum(is_campaign_day)) AS avg_plt_gmv_usd_7d_excl_camp_day
```

### Pattern 5: 统计各窗口 campaign 天数（potential product 场景）

```sql
SELECT
    sum(if(date(campaign_day) BETWEEN date('${PREV_7D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 1, 0)) AS campaign_7d,
    sum(if(date(campaign_day) BETWEEN date('${PREV_14D}') AND date('${PREV_8D}'), 1, 0)) AS campaign_14d
FROM mp_paidads.dim_campaign_day__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Diagnosis - 找最近 3 个非 campaign day 用于基线计算

```sql
order_avg_dates AS (
    SELECT grass_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            calendar_dates.grass_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY calendar_dates.grass_date DESC) AS date_rank
        FROM (
            SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(
                DATE_SUB(DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 31),
                DATE_SUB(DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 2),
                INTERVAL 1 DAY
            )) AS grass_date
        ) calendar_dates
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(campaign_day) AS campaign_day
            FROM mp_paidads.dim_campaign_day__reg_s0_live
            WHERE tz_type = 'local'
              AND grass_region = UPPER('${grass_region}')
              AND grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
              AND TO_DATE(campaign_day) BETWEEN
                  DATE_SUB(DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 31)
                  AND DATE_SUB(DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 2)
        ) campaign_day_t ON calendar_dates.grass_date = campaign_day_t.campaign_day
        WHERE campaign_day_t.campaign_day IS NULL
    ) valid_dates
    WHERE date_rank <= 3
)
```

### Snippet 5: Item RCMD - 统计不同窗口 campaign 天数

```sql
cache table campaign_days OPTIONS ('storageLevel' 'MEMORY_ONLY') as (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN campaign_7d < 7 THEN sequence(date('${PREV_7D}'), date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'))
            ELSE sequence(date('${PREV_14D}'), date('${PREV_8D}'))
        END AS grass_date_7D,
        CASE
            WHEN campaign_7d < 7 THEN sequence(date('${PREV_14D}'), date('${PREV_8D}'))
            ELSE sequence(date('${PREV_21D}'), date('${PREV_15D}'))
        END AS grass_date_14D,
        CASE WHEN campaign_7d < 7 THEN campaign_7d ELSE campaign_14d END AS campaign_days_7d,
        CASE WHEN campaign_7d < 7 THEN campaign_14d ELSE campaign_21d END AS campaign_days_14d
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sum(if(date(campaign_day) BETWEEN date('${PREV_7D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 1, 0)) AS campaign_7d,
            sum(if(date(campaign_day) BETWEEN date('${PREV_14D}') AND date('${PREV_8D}'), 1, 0)) AS campaign_14d,
            sum(if(date(campaign_day) BETWEEN date('${PREV_21D}') AND date('${PREV_15D}'), 1, 0)) AS campaign_21d
        FROM mp_paidads.dim_campaign_day__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
          AND grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
    )
);
```

### 分区写入策略

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dim_campaign_day__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (tz_type='local', grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
    id,
    campaign_name,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(
        date(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(cast(start_time as timestamp), 'Asia/Singapore'), '${timezone}')),
        date(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(cast(end_time as timestamp), 'Asia/Singapore'), '${timezone}')),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
    )) AS campaign_day,
    UPPER('${region}') AS grass_region,
    DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AS grass_date
FROM mp_paidads.shopee_ads_${region}_central_db__campaign_day_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live
WHERE COALESCE(CAST(get_json_object(_decoded_extinfo, '$.is_not_campaign_day') AS BOOLEAN), FALSE) = FALSE
```

### 生产逻辑要点

- 将每个 campaign 的 `start_time` 到 `end_time` 按 local 时区展开为逐日记录
- 排除标记为 `is_not_campaign_day` 的记录
- 每个区域独立运行，写入各自分区
- 分区 `tz_type` 固定为 `'local'`
